acceptanceCriteria: STUB-ON-PATH: a stub on a first-party symbol whose return value flows to an asserted value is reported with stubbed symbol, action line and assertion line (RSpec and Jest/Vitest at least); stubs on external boundaries (HTTP clients, third-party SDKs, clock, queues) are not reported.

STUB-NEVER-INVOKED: a stub in the example or its hooks on a method a bound passing run with call recording never invoked is reported; without a run, it is advisory only when static analysis finds no call path from the action; incomplete analysis abstains.
Requirements in test-source-analysis-v0.md (lane-assigned TSA range) with traceability; focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; build-log entry; Closes #1171.
body: GitHub #1171. Beyond DESCRIBED-CLASS-STUBBED, reviewers find (1) stubs of first-party collaborators between the action and the asserted value, so the assertion checks the stub, and (2) stubs on methods the exercised path never calls (wrong receiver, renamed method). Requested STUB-ON-PATH (first-party stub/double/receive/mockReturnValue whose value flows into an asserted value; external boundaries excluded) and STUB-NEVER-INVOKED (from recorded call data, advisory from static no-call-path).
title: GH #1171: test-validity: flag first-party collaborator stubs on the action-to-assertion path (STUB-ON-PATH) and stubs never invoked (STUB-NEVER-INVOKED)
